title: Fuzz it and fix it
description:
Fuzz the save file loader and fix every crash or hang it finds.

```
seed 7, 200,000 inputs
found: count 0xFFFFFFFF makes a huge allocation -> fixed
found: name length past the end -> fixed
after fixes: 0 failures in 1,000,000 inputs
```
hints: Several kinds of mutation chosen at random find more than any one kind (lesson 17.03).
Build with `-fsanitize=address,undefined` (or MSVC's `/fsanitize=address`) so memory bugs stop at once.
requirements: Generate inputs by mutating a valid save: flip bits, change counts, cut the end, repeat bytes.
Run the loader on each; record any input that throws something unexpected, crashes (with a sanitizer) or takes too long.
Keep failing inputs as files so the fixed bug can be tested again.
stretch: Use libFuzzer's `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput` with Clang for coverage-guided fuzzing.
